stem: What is the most likely reason the playwright uses the figurative language in this line?
instruction:
Read line 24.

[Distracted by her own conversation, Sophia turns again toward Maggie and Allen, who both have their eyes glued to the water.]

options.label: A
options.text: To suggest that Maggie and Allen are tired from squinting for so long

options.label: B
options.text: To show that Maggie and Allen are focused intently on spotting the whales

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that Maggie and Allen need binoculars if they want to see whales

options.label: D
options.text: To show that Maggie and Allen have trouble noticing objects in plain sight
